snippet.title: Fine Work 2024 Alpha Gameplay Sizzle Reel
snippet.description:
This video features gameplay from the pre-release demo of Fine Work: Act I! We hope you enjoy seeing all the updates and changes we've made since! 

Fine Work: Act I is available now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2752240/Fine_Work_Act_I/ 

---

Our team is excited to share shiny, new gameplay of our upcoming game Fine Work! Sendshapers know that rich memories make the best materials. In this Rhythm Game x Visual Novel, you'll transmute patrons' memories into beautiful artifacts. What have your clients seen? And do they sense what's coming?

Our demo is available now on Steam. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2752240/Fine_Work/#app_reviews_hash

Features:
➤Craft your way through 21 rhythmic dreamscapes to a glittering OST
➤Build striking, tender relationships with 7 core characters 
➤Unravel and alter intersecting storylines across three escalating acts
➤Gather notes about the world and the strange beings therein
➤Revisit discovered locations, scenes, and memories in the gallery 

Visit www.Fine.Work for more!
